summary: The note explains diversification as a strategy for SME stability and growth, defined as expanding into new products, services, or markets to open revenue streams and reduce reliance on one segment. It presents examples from tech, fashion, food and beverage, biotech, and retail, covering new markets, partnerships, R&D, and digital transformation. It closes by stressing risk management through market research, a clear strategy, and a phased approach.
one_line: Diversification tactics for SMEs, illustrated by tech, fashion, food, biotech and retail examples, plus advice on managing risk.
key_facts: Diversification means a company broadening operations by introducing new products, services, or markets, which can open new revenue streams and reduce reliance on its original market segment.
On September 12, 2023, at the SME Growth Conference in Toronto, Dr. Matthew Chan said SMEs should view diversification "not as a luxury but as an essential component of their growth strategy."
Dr. Matthew Chan described diversification as "building resiliency in the face of constant change."
On October 22, 2023, InnoSoftTech, a mid-sized software firm focused on custom enterprise software for the finance sector, announced expansion into machine learning and data analytics.

Eliza Goldstein, CEO of boutique fashion SME Gold Textiles, said at the Global Fashion Summit on November 4, 2023, that entry into the Asian market now accounts for 25% of the company's annual revenue.
Hops Haven (microbrewery) and Bread & Butter (artisanal bakery) met at a local trade fair on February 7, 2024, and collaborated on a line of beer-infused bread, producing a sales peak and local buzz.
Biotech SME GenResearch saw a 40% increase in market valuation after announcing on April 15, 2024, that its R&D had produced a new gene therapy technique.
Dr. Fiona Reyes, CEO of GenResearch, credited the success to diversification and R&D investment, saying it equips the company to serve wider societal needs.
Everyday Essentials, a small brick-and-mortar retailer, adopted an e-commerce platform on January 9, 2024, widening its customer base and revenue streams beyond the high street.
The note recommends managing diversification risks through in-depth market research, a clear diversification strategy, and alignment with overall business goals.

Jordan Mills, a financial consultant specializing in SME growth, said at the European SME Finance Forum on March 14, 2024, that diversification should be "a series of calculated steps rather than a leap of faith."
